evidence: The frozen workbook Quality Checks A10:D10 requires sane CPU/memory, no secret literals and public networking. Its Internal Quality Checks row 10 retains historical no-network wording; the current main row, frozen SKILL.md:26 and quality-checks.md:43-45 explicitly override that wording. Frozen task/task.toml:20-24 declares exactly build_timeout_sec=600.0, network_mode="public", cpus=2 and memory_mb=4096. Python tomllib inspection confirms this entire [environment] table equals the frozen template and contains neither docker_image nor allow_internet. Two CPUs and 4 GiB are a sane declared allocation for this single Node/Express/SQLite app with a browser frontend; integration.md:3 allows frontend tools to be chosen, with no mandated large auxiliary backend. task/environment/Dockerfile:1-26 is byte-identical to the frozen template; its only ENV is NODE_PATH, and lines 14-15 copy only the six inspected instruction files and the empty synthetic seed file. All those source bytes were read: there is no provider key, PEM block, password or other credential literal in the image sources; turing@local.invalid at Dockerfile:20 is synthetic Git metadata. task.toml:34 uses the allowed ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} verifier template, not a secret literal. policy.md:7 and integration.md:13 allow public network/browser assets, while security.md:9 restricts only authored snippet code, so those statements do not silently disable app development networking. Recomputed all 17 relevant frozen source/rule/template SHA256 values and confirmed each against manifest.json; in particular task.toml=17d5c69747a3c372b8fb1270a651cdff8b7a23a0e0ec9f03d7c026fbe6454802, agent/template Dockerfile=0a75419e9598ded9317b26bbf0d2b12de0b9b11185fb4c9fed1ca7f3e52467d1, supplied workbook=6d44970b2ff67fefad1e2327e743fc226fcd4c50ff55baf899f41069a9b3fd7f and skill=8f2b660d1d32df90eb50990f401a0fc23a2ccbbcd49eeb5730bfbb9bef2bebc3. Current review-policy hash also matches manifest engine_inputs. This is a source/configuration verdict for row 9 only; no container resource enforcement, cold-build duration, private deterministic checker execution, full configured judge completion, Oracle, target-model or portal result is claimed.
counterexample: Adversarial reasoning only, not runtime execution: a static fake playground could still use this correctly provisioned environment and pass row 9; this row does not measure product behavior or award app reward. It therefore supplies no evidence that such an app passes the verifier. A conforming implementation that downloads an editor package during development or loads a CDN editor/font remains allowed by public network_mode, integration.md:13 and policy.md:7; the snippet-only network restriction does not make that conforming alternative fail the environment requirement. No row-9 defect was identified by either challenge.
